title: [29.x][Genrate Lines from Allocation Account Line leaves incorrect Non-deductible VAT amounts when Prices Including VAT is enabled.
summary: Fixed a bug where generating purchase lines from allocation account entries calculated incorrect non-deductible VAT amounts when prices include VAT.
key_points: Corrects non-deductible VAT calculation in purchase allocation account line generation
Issue occurred specifically when prices including VAT mode was enabled
Fix applied to Purchase Allocation Account Management codeunit
Test coverage added across multiple localization layers (W1, IT, NL, NO)
Affects the allocation account feature for purchase transactions
